title: 第13章 开府2第14章 第一次早朝
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧风在大殿上写完恩后，跟着其他皇子来到了御书房，萧雅也在这里，萧鼎锋之前收到了小顺子的折子，知道萧风想认这个小丫头为义妹，今天便让刘雨也将小丫头带了过来。
萧雅，看着周围多了很多陌生的人，还是怯生生的躲在了萧风的背后，萧鼎锋挥手让小丫头上前来，小丫头不敢，萧风只能是开口劝小丫头，让小丫头走到了萧鼎锋身边，萧鼎锋看着上前来的小丫头，小丫头穿着一身碧绿的小裙子，怯生生的看着萧鼎锋，便对萧风说：“这丫头的名字你已经取过了，那我就封她给碧落公主吧，让她跟着在你府中生活，也算上朕的干女儿。”
萧风慌忙的上前谢恩，刘雨将萧雅带下去后，萧鼎锋又问了些朝政问题，便让其他皇子退下了，单独留下了萧风，萧鼎锋开口道：“刺杀你的人，朕已经知道了，你想知道是谁吗？”
萧风摇了摇头，“是谁不重要，重要的是我现在不是好端端的站在这里吗？所以是谁又有什么关系呢？”
萧鼎锋满意的点了点头，一副孺子可教的表情，于是开口道：“我知道你能修炼了，也知道你那几个护卫修为不错，看来，我一直低估你了。”
萧风没有接话，只是静静的看着萧鼎锋，殿中一时间气氛很微妙，这对父子俩相互都在试探，萧风没接话的原因很简单，他对萧鼎锋施展了侦察术，结果将他震惊在了原地。
姓名：萧鼎锋
身份：旭日王朝皇帝
年龄：45
根骨：天阶五级
天赋：天阶五级
修为：天阶2级
功法：玄黄经
武技：雪魄刀法
萧风真的没想到，原来萧鼎锋的修为这么高，看来萧鼎锋是有实力冲击圣阶啊，这便宜老爹是真的厉害。
正在萧风愣神的时候，萧鼎锋开口了：“你现在什么修为了？”
萧风随后便释放了气势，萧鼎锋感受了一下之后，便让萧风收敛了气势，开口道：“不错，黄阶巅峰了，比我在第一次见你的时候，强出了一大截，但是你觉得够吗？”萧鼎锋也释放出了气势。
萧风感受到了巨大的压力，但是咬着牙就是不愿屈服，萧鼎锋看着咬牙坚持的萧风，又加大了一点，萧风还是咬着牙，但是就是没有屈服，萧鼎锋随后撤去了气势，萧风一下子感觉又活过来了，而且他明显感觉到黄阶巅峰的气海有了松动的气象。
萧鼎锋看着萧风，很满意，便说：“朕给你300的府兵，弥补你一些，朕知道你已经安排人去查刺杀之人了，希望你放过他一次，朕会再给你一些补偿。”
萧风听着萧鼎锋的话，点了点头，开口问道：“父皇刚刚用的是哪个等级的气势？”
萧鼎锋看着萧风，说道：“地阶一级。”
萧风听后，也是对自己的有了一个新的认知。
萧鼎锋对萧风说：“你从明日开始正常上朝吧，开始接触朝堂之事，现在就没什么事了，回你的汉王府看看吧。”
“儿臣告退。”萧风行礼之后便退出去了。
萧风在外面看到了等候的萧雅，刘雨看着萧风走了出来，上前对萧风说：“汉王殿下，府兵的编制已经在兵部走完流程了，您是自己招募还是要怎么再从禁军中选一些？”
content_en:
After Xiao Feng finished writing his favor in the main hall, he followed the other princes to the Imperial Study Room, where Xiao Ya was also here. Xiao Dingfeng had received a note from Xiao Shunzi before, and knew that Xiao Feng wanted to recognize this little girl as his adopted sister, so he asked Liu Yu to bring the little girl over today.
Xiao Ya, seeing many strangers around, still timidly hid behind Xiao Feng. Xiao Dingfeng waved the little girl to come forward, but the little girl didn't dare. Xiao Feng could only persuade the little girl and let the little girl walk to Xiao Dingfeng. Xiao Dingfeng watched and stepped forward. The little girl came. She was wearing a small green skirt. She looked at Xiao Dingfeng timidly and said to Xiao Feng: "You have already chosen this girl's name. Then I will name her Princess Biluo and let her live in your house and be considered my goddaughter."
Xiao Feng hurriedly stepped forward to thank him. After Liu Yu took Xiao Ya down, Xiao Dingfeng asked some questions about government affairs, then asked the other princes to retreat, leaving Xiao Feng alone. Xiao Dingfeng said: "I already know the person who assassinated you. Do you want to know who it is?"
Xiao Feng shook his head, "It doesn't matter who it is. What's important is that I'm not standing here properly now? So what does it matter who it is?"
Xiao Dingfeng nodded with satisfaction, with a childish expression on his face, and said, "I know you can practice, and I also know that your guards have good cultivation. It seems that I have always underestimated you."
Xiao Feng didn't answer, but just looked at Xiao Dingfeng quietly. The atmosphere in the palace was very subtle for a while. The father and son were testing each other. The reason why Xiao Feng didn't answer was simple. He used the reconnaissance technique on Xiao Dingfeng, and the result was that he was shocked on the spot.
Name: Xiao Dingfeng
Identity: Emperor of the Rising Sun Dynasty
Age: 45
Root Bone: Level 5 of Heaven Level
Talent: Heaven Level 5
Cultivation level: Heaven level 2
Kung Fu: Xuanhuang Sutra
Martial Arts: Snow Soul Sword Technique
Xiao Feng really didn't expect that Xiao Dingfeng's cultivation level was so high. It seemed that Xiao Dingfeng had the strength to reach the holy level. This cheap old man was really powerful.
While Xiao Feng was stunned, Xiao Dingfeng spoke: "What level of cultivation are you at now?"
Xiao Feng then released his momentum. After Xiao Dingfeng felt it for a while, he asked Xiao Feng to restrain his momentum and said, "Yes, Huang Jie has reached the peak. It is much stronger than when I first met you, but do you think it is enough?" Xiao Dingfeng also released his momentum.
Xiao Feng felt tremendous pressure, but he gritted his teeth and refused to give in. Xiao Dingfeng looked at Xiao Feng who gritted his teeth and persisted, and increased the pressure a little more. Xiao Feng still gritted his teeth, but did not give in. Xiao Dingfeng then withdrew his momentum. Xiao Feng suddenly felt alive again, and he clearly felt that the Qi sea at the peak of Huang Jie was loosening.
Xiao Dingfeng looked at Xiao Feng, very satisfied, and said: "I will give you 300 soldiers to make up for it. I know that you have arranged people to investigate the assassin. I hope you let him go once, and I will give you some compensation."
Xiao Feng listened to Xiao Dingfeng's words, nodded, and asked: "What level of momentum did your father just use?"
Xiao Dingfeng looked at Xiao Feng and said: "First level of earth level."
After Xiao Feng heard this, he also had a new understanding of himself.
Xiao Dingfeng said to Xiao Feng: "You can go to court normally from tomorrow and start to get in touch with the affairs of the court. There will be nothing else to do now. Go back to your Prince Han's Mansion."
"My dear, please retire." Xiao Feng bowed and left.
Xiao Feng saw Xiao Ya waiting outside. Liu Yu watched Xiao Feng come out and stepped forward and said to Xiao Feng: "Your Highness, the King of Han, the preparation of the imperial troops has been completed at the Ministry of War. Do you want to recruit them yourself or do you want to select more from the Forbidden Army?"
